name: Roshutsu Mesu
source:
Shota was an average kid with not-too-good study habits.
Arisa, his sister, was an idol figure and an excellent student.
To help inspire her little brother, Arisa makes a promise to Shota:

"Match my grades," she teases, "and I'll do anything for you."

Now he's got the goal of having his way with her.
At first he photographs her naked, beautiful body, but from there it escalates.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ069080.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
Shota是一个普通的孩子，学习习惯不太好。
他的妹妹亚里沙是一位偶像人物，也是一名优秀的学生。
为了激励弟弟，亚里沙向翔太做出承诺：

“只要你的成绩符合我的要求，”她开玩笑说，“我会为你做任何事。”

现在他的目标是随心所欲地对待她。
起初，他拍摄了她赤裸、美丽的身体，但从那时起，事情就升级了。
